name: Giant-Dueler (Combat)
body:
You are skilled at parrying foes that outmatch you in terms of size.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 15, parry class feature

Benefit: When you attempt to parry an attack made by a creature of a larger size category, you only suffer a -2 penalty to your attack roll for each size category that the attacker is larger than you. In addition, when you successfully parry a such an attack, you gain a +1 bonus per size category that the attacker is larger to your next melee attack roll made within 1 round against that creature.

Normal: Normally you suffer a -4 penalty to your parry attack roll for each size category that the attacker is larger than you.
